THIRD-PARTY COMPONENTS
======================

Mesa3D / Mesa for Windows
Project: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/mesa/mesa
Windows distribution: https://github.com/pal1000/mesa-dist-win
Bundled version: 26.2.0
Used component: llvmpipe software OpenGL renderer.
Mesa source files are distributed under their respective open-source licenses.
See the upstream project for exact per-file license information.

IntegerScaler
Project: https://tanalin.com/en/projects/integer-scaler/
Bundled version: 2.20 x64 (official unmodified binary from the author)
Status: closed-source freeware.
IntegerScaler remains the property of its author. See the upstream project page
for the original download and current terms.

Minecraft On OLD GPU does not include Minecraft itself.
